class.name: FmodAudioStream
class.brief_description: An audio stream playing FMOD's output through Godot's audio server.
class.description: Plays FMOD's whole mix when [member FmodGeneralSettings.output_routing] sends it to a Godot bus, and silence otherwise. [FmodServer] already plays one on the configured bus, from [method FmodServer.init] to [method FmodServer.shutdown]: play no other, since each would read FMOD's mix.
